newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices fall on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices fall on profit-taking.

text.p: Indian cotton prices fell on Tuesday on profit-taking prompted by increased offerings from state agencies, dealers said.
Fresh demand at higher levels, also eased.
"Export deals remained thin and hardly a few thousand bales were traded at the rate of 57.50/60 cents per pound," one broker said.

In spot deals Punjab saw-ginned slid by 25 rupees to 1,675/1,700 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while F-414 fell by 10/15 rupees to 1,910/1,940 rupees per maund. Gujarat wagad slid by 100 rupees to 10,400/10,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
